description: Bulk form of upsert_dictionary_word: adds or updates many glossary entries in ONE load/save (use this instead of calling upsert_dictionary_word in a loop — each single call costs several server requests and counts against the per-minute cap). Same per-item semantics (upsert by logicalWord, physical words uppercased); later duplicates in the batch win; all-or-nothing; standard-linked dictionaries rejected with dictionary_is_linked.
